newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro RSCG wins Sara Lee Europe accounts.
newsitem.headline: Euro RSCG wins Sara Lee Europe accounts.

text.p: French advertising agency Euro RSCG Worldwide said on Friday it had won the accounts to advertise Sara Lee Corp brands Playtex and Wonderbra in Europe.
New advertisements from the brands' intimate apparel will begin appearing in the second half of this year, said Euro RSCG, part of Havas Advertising .
